title: RWKV-UNet: Improving UNet with Long-Range Cooperation for Effective Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: Encoder of Global-Local Spatial Perception blocks mixing convolutions with RWKV linear attention, plus a Cross-Channel Mix module for multi-scale skip fusion.
adaptation: 1-channel input, 512 px. RWKV gives global context (busbar grid, half-cut edge, scuff orientation) at linear cost, while conv branches keep 1 px crack detail. Train with both the house recipe and the PF fine-tune.
min_experiment: RWKV-UNet against house and house PF, 3 seeds, 20k steps; metric E1 crack relF1@2, E1 inactive IoU, test-49 crack IoU. Kill: under +0.03 E1 relF1@2, or test crack IoU worse by more than 0.01.
evidence: R: SOTA claimed on 11 datasets. In the independent U-Bench (28 2D datasets) it ranks top-1 IoU both in-domain and zero-shot.
